title: Sections & Reordering The Layout - Resume Builder - Design Mode
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Are you ready to take your resume to the next level?  In this video, we dive deep into the essential sections of your resume and how to effectively reorder and relabel them for maximum impact! Whether you're entering the job market for the first time or looking to refresh your existing resume, this tutorial is packed with tips to help you stand out. 

What We Will Cover:
- How to reorder sections on your resume 
- Tips for relabeling sections for clarity 
- Managing content visibility in design mode 
- Best practices for showcasing skills and experience 
- Strategies for streamlining your resume design 
- Duplicating resumes for consistency across applications 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How do I rearrange sections on my resume? 
- Can I relabel sections like "Work Experience"? 
- What should I put at the top of my resume? 
- How does the design mode affect my resume layout? 
- Will changes I make apply to all my resumes?
